title: Finite Hom comparison and augmented tower maps
statement: Fix universes $d,t,u$, a prime $\ell$, a field $E$ finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $Y$ in universe $t$, a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$ in universe $d$, and $\ell\ne p$. On the small pro-etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $B=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_Y$ be the coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(B)$ and $D(B_n)$ of module sheaves at coefficient universe $\max(u,t+1)$. Write $H_B,H_{B_n}$ for the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $F_n:D(B)\to D(B_n)$ for derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and $Q$ for complex localization. Fix $K\in D(B)$, complexes $P,G,P\prime,G\prime$, K-flat resolutions $q:P\to G$ and $q\prime:P\prime\to G\prime$, and an isomorphism $e:QG\prime\simeq H_B(K,QG)$. Let $T(P)$ be the recorded quotient tower [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] and $\gamma_{q,n}:QG\to T(P)_n$ its canonical augmentation [lem-weil-integral-reduction-tower-well-defined]. Put $H=H_B(K,-)$ and write $r_n:T(P)_{n+1}\to T(P)_n$ and $r\prime_n:T(P\prime)_{n+1}\to T(P\prime)_n$ for consecutive transitions. There are isomorphisms $\theta_n:H(T(P)_n)\simeq T(P\prime)_n$ satisfying $H(r_n)\theta_n=\theta_{n+1}r\prime_n$ and $e^{-1}\gamma_{q\prime,n}=H(\gamma_{q,n})\theta_n$ for every $n\ge0$. Neither product existence nor completeness is assumed; the resolutions and $e$ are fixed, not chosen in the conclusion.

proof.text: Choose the signed tensor-Hom natural transformation alpha. Each alpha(Q_n) is degreewise invertible by the existing two-term free criterion; hence its complex map, its localization and the resulting tower transformation are invertible.

proof.text: Conjugate the inverse localized signed comparison by s and t inverse. Naturality of this single tower isomorphism gives the consecutive-transition equation.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the localized signed comparison to the actual coefficient-unit map R[0] -> Q_n. Precompose with e inverse followed by t0. Its normalization at R[0] identifies this composite with s0. The two separate model augmentation equations then give equality after postcomposition with the invertible t_n and alpha(Q_n); cancel these to obtain the claimed augmentation equation for the same family.

theorem reductionTower_components
    (K : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl)
    (P G P' G' : CochainComplex (completedIntegralModuleSheaves l E Y D hl) ℤ)
    (q : P ⟶ G) (q' : P' ⟶ G')
    (hq : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q)
    (hq' : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q')
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G' ≅
      (hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj
        (op K, DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) :
    let H := (Functor.curry.obj
      (hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl))).obj (op K)
    ∃ θ : ∀ n : ℕ, H.obj ((integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P).obj (op n)) ≅
        (integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P').obj (op n),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        H.map ((integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P).map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op) ≫
          (θ n).hom = (θ (n + 1)).hom ≫
            (integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P').map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, e.inv ≫ (integralReductionTowerCone l E Y D hl q' hq').π.app (op n) =
        H.map ((integralReductionTowerCone l E Y D hl q hq).π.app (op n)) ≫
          (θ n).hom
